AccountsPage.accountsHint: Add your accounts and follower counts, up to {max}. The order here is the order on your page.
AccountsPage.rowError: Enter a valid username (English letters, numbers, . _ -) and the follower count.
AccountsPage.verificationWarning: This account is verified or in review. Saving this change removes the verification and you'll need to verify it again.
AccountsPage.savedReset: ✓ Changes saved. Accounts you changed are no longer verified; verify them again in Verification.
AccountsPage.monthlyViewsHint: Type each platform's views for the month; we add them up into one number on your page. Leave them empty to hide the box.

AccountsPage.viewsHidden: The box is hidden on your page.

ai.hint: Upload screenshots of your audience stats from the app (up to {max} at once: gender, ages, countries...). Each image only fills what it shows.

ai.failed: We couldn't read the screenshot; try a clearer one or fill it in manually.

linkHint.spotify: Open your Spotify page (podcast or artist), tap Share → Copy link.

linkHint.jaco: Open your Jaco profile, tap Share → Copy link.

AccountsPage.audienceProOnly: Your audience data is saved, but it shows on your page with Pro only.

connect.title: Connect your {platform} account
connect.why: Once connected, your followers and audience update by themselves every day, and your account is verified without a screenshot.
connect.whyFollowers: Once connected, your followers update by themselves every day, and your account is verified without a screenshot. You still fill in the audience data yourself.

checkErrors.not_admin: The bot isn't an admin of {handle} yet. Add it as an admin of the channel with that exact username, then try again in a few seconds.
checkErrors.expired: Tap “Connect Telegram” first, then add the bot and tap “Check the link” within 30 minutes.
checkErrors.taken: This channel is linked to another Wsool page.
checkErrors.gone: We couldn't find this account on your page. Refresh and try again.
checkErrors.pro: Linking accounts is available on Pro only.

botSteps.2: Pick your channel {handle} and add the Wsool bot as an admin (no extra rights needed).
botSteps.3: Come back and tap “Check the link”. The channel must be public, with the same username.

connect.saveFirst: Save the account first, then you can connect it.
connect.paused: Automatic updates are paused because your page is on the Basic plan. Your numbers stay as last updated, and updates resume by themselves with Pro.
connect.proOnly: Linking accounts so their numbers update by themselves is part of Pro. You can still type your numbers and verify them with a screenshot.
connect.confirmUnlink: Disconnect {platform}? Your numbers will stop updating by themselves; the verification stays until it expires.
connect.locked: The username and followers come straight from the platform and update by themselves.
connect.done: {platform} connected ✓ Your numbers are up to date and update by themselves, and your account is verified.

errors.denied: Not connected: you need to allow access on the platform's page.
errors.taken: This account is already connected to another Wsool page.
errors.no_channel: We found no channel on that account. Pick the account that has your channel.
errors.no_server: The server from your invite link isn't one you own or manage. Check the link and sign in with the server owner's account.
errors.expired: The connection timed out. Please try again.
errors.gone: We couldn't find this account on your page. Refresh and try again.
errors.unavailable: Connecting this platform isn't available right now.
errors.pro: Linking accounts is available on Pro only.
errors.failed: Something went wrong while connecting. Please try again.
errors.no_page: We couldn't find a Facebook Page matching this account. Make sure you picked your Page on Facebook's screen and the username here is the Page's.

connect.igProfessional: Needs an Instagram professional account (creator or business). If yours is personal, switch for free in Instagram: Settings → Account type and tools → Switch to professional account.
connect.fbPage: Links a Facebook Page, not a personal profile. On Facebook's screen pick your Page and keep the permissions on. Facebook doesn't share audience data, so fill it from a stats screenshot.

AccountsPage.audienceNotFromPlatform: {platform} doesn't share audience data when linked, so you still fill it in: tap “Fill from a stats screenshot” and upload a screenshot of your account's stats.

WorkPage.brandsHint: Upload brand logos, up to {max}. They scroll across your page.
WorkPage.logoHint: PNG with a transparent background works best, or JPG/WebP, up to 4 MB. You can pick several at once.
WorkPage.worksHint: Videos of your past ads (upload or link), up to {max}. Visitors tap a work to watch it.
WorkPage.freeLimit: On the Basic plan only your first {n} works show on your page. Put the best ones first.
WorkPage.videoHint: MP4 or MOV up to 50 MB. The cover is taken from the start of the video; you can change it.
WorkPage.addLink: Or paste a link from your account
WorkPage.linkHint: A video link from TikTok, Instagram or YouTube. We get the cover from the platform; you can change it.
WorkPage.linkInvalid: That link doesn't work. Paste a video link from TikTok, Instagram or YouTube.
WorkPage.fetchCover: Get the cover from the platform

RatesPage.showOnPageHint: When hidden, visitors see "Rates on request".
RatesPage.needAccounts: Add your accounts first, then you can set a rate for each platform.

RatesPage.proOnly: Your rates are saved, but they show on your page with Pro only.

ContactPage.intro: Brands contact you from your page with one tap. Leave a field empty to hide it.

AppearancePage.lockWholeHint: Visitors see your photo, name and specialty only; the rest opens with your password or a private link.
AppearancePage.privatePro: The private view is a Pro feature.
AppearancePage.privateNote: Manage the password and private links in Privacy & visibility.

Suspended.title: Your account is suspended
Suspended.body: The Wsool team has suspended your account and your page is hidden from visitors. Your data is kept and nothing was deleted. To ask why or appeal, contact us.
Suspended.whatsappText: Hi, my Wsool account is suspended and I'd like to know why

VerificationPage.how1: Open your profile in the app and take a screenshot showing the username and follower count.

VerificationPage.noAccounts: Add your accounts first to verify them.

faq.a: No. While a creator is linked to your agency, their page is on Pro as part of the agency plan.

faq.q: What happens if a creator unlinks?
faq.a: The agency loses access right away, and the creator gets 14 days of Pro free; then they subscribe or move to Basic without losing anything.

faq.q: Can I create a page for a creator without an account?
faq.a: Yes. You fill in their details, they get an email to claim the page, and it stays hidden until they do.

faq.q: Can the agency link a creator's platform accounts?
faq.a: Linking Instagram, TikTok and others must be done by the creator, because the platforms require the account owner's consent. After that the numbers update automatically in your dashboard.

faq.q: When will the agency plan be available?
faq.a: Soon. We're starting with a limited number of agencies on a free trial. Request the trial and we'll get in touch.
